svg.title: Export As DK Project
svg.desc: Export As DK Project Create a new DK project file from the current project. Generates a new .dkproject file containing the project information required for the corresponding DK workflow. Project File Generation: Creates a new .dkproject file. Project Transfer: Packages the required project information into the DK project format. Workflow Preparation: Provides the project file required for subsequent DK processing.
